en.role: political party; platform for the State Duma election
en.head: Inflation was 6.1% in 2011.
en.body: Rosstat recorded a 6.1% increase in consumer prices from December 2010 to December 2011. The party programme’s target for 2011 was 5%. Both figures are full-year measures.
